player_knew_note: the five U8 frames are left out of these counts; the 7 decayed frames each also got the 'abandoned' line after, but it gives the share at the last tick (0-1%), not what had been built (11-73%)
mechanisms: Advanced generators (5000 energy each; a basic solar costs none) and a third plant begun in an empty energy store crawl (32% after 70 s) and were then dropped by the player for basic solars: a builder's entry saying how long the frame takes at the current energy income, or the energy price of an advanced solar before it is listed, would have kept them unstarted; armadvsol_25662, armadvsol_12344, armvp_6172: 291 metal.

Builds sited beside a builder that stands in a plant's exit lane (the pick's 'beside itself' solar, two unplaced 'armadvsol' list steps) were each dropped by the player with `stop` to clear plant_30437's lane; siting unplaced and beside-itself builds outside the exit lanes (or naming the lane in the tool's result for an unplaced step) would have kept armsolar_24908, armadvsol_26536, armadvsol_12142: 234 metal.

A builder walked off a started frame by the pick (a lone Tick, under the packet's 'walk to home and come back when it is gone') is never sent back to it: the frame came from a replaced list, so the new list's unplaced step began a fresh solar where the builder stood, 400 from the 73% frame; returning a builder to its own frame after a diversion would have kept armsolar_1515: 113 metal. (Close behind: a builder whose change reads 0.76-0.83 under a lone Pawn while no move reaches the 0.5 flag is never moved, armllt_21831 and its 135-metal constructor.)
side_findings: Report: 'abandoned an unfinished X (N% built)' gives the frame's share on the last tick before it died (briefing.rs `unfinished`, refreshed every tick), so every decayed frame read 0-1%: armsolar_1515 at 73% was reported '1% built'.

Report: a builder's entry takes the most advanced frame of its type within 200 of the task's place (picture.rs task_course), so three builders at solar_field all read 27% then 32% while constructor_426's own frame stood at 4-8%.

frames.py: 13 of the 36 'never started' entries were not: 11 builders helped another builder's frame at the same site (no `created` by them) and 2 frames were placed 320 and 472 from the ordered point.
unread: nothing torn; the hands' log read for 6:44-7:08, 12:17-12:58 and spot frames at 6:51-6:52 and 12:44-12:45; the U8 frames and the never-started orders were read from the record's decision rows and the sweep's hands' lines, not the hands' log
